```yaml
name: Publish Skills

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '^\.skills/|^skill\.md$'

      - name: Determine skills to publish
        id: determine
        run: |
          echo "Determining skills to publish"
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "force=true"
            skills=$(find .skills -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf "%f\n")
          else
            echo "force=false"
            changed_files=$(echo '${{ steps.changed.outputs.all }}' | jq -r '.[]')
            skills_set=()
            for file in $changed_files; do
              if [[ "$file" =~ ^\.skills/([^/]+)/ ]]; then
                skill=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
                skills_set+=("$skill")
              fi
            done
            skills=$(printf "%s\n" "${skills_set[@]}" | sort -u)
          fi
          echo "skills=$skills" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          curl -sL https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/download/v0.7.0/clawhub_0.7.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/clawhub

      - name: Login to ClawHub
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          clawhub login --token $CLAWHUB_TOKEN

      - name: Publish skills
        if: steps.determine.outputs.skills != ''
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "${{ steps.determine.outputs.skills }}" | while read -r skill; do
            echo "Publishing skill: $skill"
            clawhub publish .skills/"$skill" --accept-license-terms
          done
```
